en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded street parade in a European city. Spectators in early‑20th‑century dress line both sides of a cobblestone street in front of tall townhouses with arched window shutters. A large decorated float drawn by two horses moves through the street; it is covered with drapery and carries several costumed figures, including a woman in white and another high on a platform. A banner on the float reads something similar to "Carnaval N E V???s Don." The angle and framing are typical of a commercial postcard photograph.
